title: 수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00005:part:1/1

Article 4 (Selection of Full-Time Fishers, etc.)
(1) A Metropolitan City Mayor, Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Do Governor, or Special Self-Governing Province Governor (hereinafter referred to as a "Mayor/Do Governor"), or the head of a Si/Gun/autonomous Gu other than an autonomous Gu of a Special Metropolitan City (hereinafter referred to as a "head of a Si/Gun/Gu") may, upon application, select a full-time fisher under Article 17 of the Act from among persons who meet all of the following requirements:
1. A fisher who engages primarily in fisheries, possesses professional fisheries technology and management capability, and is capable of playing a leading role in the development of fisheries;
2. A fisher who has at least 15 years of experience in fisheries or is recognized as having an equivalent level of technical expertise.
(2) A Mayor/Do Governor or head of a Si/Gun/Gu may provide full-time fishers with education and training, management guidance, financial support, etc. necessary for fisheries management.
(3) Matters necessary for fostering full-time fishers other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.
